## Who it is for

Engineers and managers who are to become the **AI leads** of their organisation: identify the right use cases, scope a project, work with providers and understand the stakes.

## Content

A complete programme combining methods, tools, project management and industrial case studies from several sectors — health, energy, transport, industry. It covers both the **technical** and the **organisational** sides of AI projects:

- architecture of AI systems and data management;
- AI project management, from needs analysis to deployment;
- skills and organisation;
- environmental, social and regulatory issues.

## Format

Delivered by Grenoble INP's professional training department (a Qualiopi-certified provider). Linked to the MIAI label of the same name. Active learning with serious games and real cases.
